driver_env.note: shipped-default column: auto now resolves to the fused Triton route on this device box; read against results/t1a1_fused (explicit fused) and results/t1a1_baseline (pre-fused default); every config waited for an idle device (shared box)

scope_dropped.reason: explicit EVOGP_EVAL_MODE=dense on a population past EVOGP_DENSE_MAX_TREE_LEN declines into per-structure specialized+iree with unbounded artifact growth and OOM-kills the job unit (pop 2048 x 123-node trees); time evoxc-dense-iree-raised (the cap pinned to the cell's tree_len) instead

cell_exclusions.rule: a (cell id, arm) entry in campaign.CELL_EXCLUSIONS is never scheduled, --full-specialized-iree included: it names a config the route cannot survive (an OOM kill / unbounded compile), not a coverage trade-off

entries.reason: explicit EVOGP_EVAL_MODE=dense on a population past EVOGP_DENSE_MAX_TREE_LEN declines into per-structure specialized+iree with unbounded artifact growth and OOM-kills the job unit (pop 2048 x 123-node trees); time evoxc-dense-iree-raised (the cap pinned to the cell's tree_len) instead

protocol.artifact_note: the disk tier's directory (exported as EVOGP_BENCH_ARTIFACT_DIR) is where `evoxc-batch-iree-artifact` points EVOGP_EVOXC_ARTIFACT_DIR; every other arm clears that variable, so only the artifact arm's cold column can be served from disk. Pass --artifact-dir (or export EVOGP_BENCH_ARTIFACT_DIR) with the same path to reuse one cache across campaigns; the default is <out>/artifacts, i.e. per run
protocol.batch_route_note: the batch route compiles ONE merged graph per population structure multiset, so its compile is expected to take minutes and a batch-arm overrun shows up as status 'timeout' with the worker log as evidence, not as a defect to be retried away
